criteria.location: H1 low within 0.18 D1 ADR above prior completed D1 20-day support
criteria.wick: lower wick >= 1.5 body and >= 0.28 H1 ATR14; close in upper 40%
criteria.momentum: close above signal high and H1 EMA15 within six completed H1 bars
criteria.adr: intraday range used <= 72% of prior completed D1 ADR20
criteria.incomplete_bar_rule: drop only the final off-cadence H1 row and the D1 row for the latest H1 calendar day; preserve recurring :10 source-session bars
